$comment: Golden retrieval corpus for the CI regression eval (scripts/eval-retrieval.ts). Facts are ingested verbatim; each query lists the fact ids that MUST appear in the top-5 for the query to count as recalled. Deliberate structure: near-duplicate pairs (dedupe), update pairs (temporal supersession + recency tie-break), cross-topic entities (entity fusion + aliasing), and procedural notes (pools). Keep this file small and reviewable — it is the tripwire for ranking regressions, not a leaderboard.

facts.content: The deploy pipeline runs on GitHub Actions and deploys staging on every merge to main.
Production deploys from the deploy pipeline require a manual approval from the on-call engineer.
We migrated the deploy pipeline from Jenkins to GitHub Actions in March.
The deploy pipeline uses pnpm, not npm, for all installs.
Always run database migrations before deploying the api service, or the health check fails.
The PostgreSQL database runs on db-primary.internal and listens on port 5432.
Postgres connection pool is capped at 20 connections per service in production.
PostgreSQL nightly backups run at 02:00 UTC and are retained for 30 days.
The reporting tool connects to the Postgres replica, never to the primary.
Kubernetes cluster prod-eu runs in Frankfurt; the staging cluster runs in Amsterdam.
Kubernetes pods for the api service autoscale between 3 and 12 replicas.
kubectl context for production is named prod-eu and requires VPN access.
The user prefers dark mode in every editor and terminal.
The user prefers concise commit messages with no body.
The user drinks coffee until noon and switches to tea afterwards.
The user's timezone is Europe/Berlin and they start work around 09:00.
Priya owns the PostgreSQL schema and reviews every migration.
Marcus is the on-call rotation lead and can approve production deploys.
Sofia maintains the Kubernetes cluster prod-eu and its ingress rules.
The 2026-06-12 incident was caused by a migration running after the deploy instead of before it.
After the 2026-06-12 incident we added a pre-deploy gate that blocks deploys when migrations are pending.
The incident postmortem for 2026-06-12 recommends canary deploys for the api service.
New engineers get repository access on day one and production access after their first week.
Onboarding step one: install Node 22, pnpm, and Docker Desktop.
Onboarding step two: run the seed script and log in with the staging SSO.
The staging SSO provider is Okta; production uses the same Okta tenant with a different app.
API keys are stored in the secrets manager, never in environment files committed to git.
Every service exposes a /health endpoint that the Kubernetes liveness probe uses.
The api service reads its config from environment variables validated by zod at boot.
We standardized on pnpm workspaces with turbo for the monorepo build.
The docs site deploys to GitHub Pages from the website folder.
Weekly sync happens Tuesdays at 14:00 Berlin time in the eng-all channel.
The staging database is a Postgres 16 instance with the same schema as production.
Redis is used for rate limiting and short-lived caches only; it is never a source of truth.
Pull requests require one approval and passing CI before merge.
Feature flags live in the flags service and default to off in production.
